## Description

Orders out (ORM^O01) and results in (ORU) with ACK handling; results land in the results inbox with identity match; radiology reports as text with DICOMweb viewer links (no image copies).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ORU messages create inbox items matched to orders; low-confidence matches still need a human.
- [ ] **AC2.** ACK/NACK handling and retries are visible in H-01.
- [ ] **AC3.** Imaging opens in the provider viewer via link only.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
